meta.prompt: Help me pick a laptop with a short question flow, one question at a time: what I use it for, then a second question that depends on that answer, then budget. Show progress, let me go back, and end on one recommendation with the reasons and a start over button.
meta.text:
The error came from the `Progress =step` line, where I bound a value to the progress bar in a way that isn't valid. I'll replace it with a plain Text line showing the step, and keep everything else the same.

Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  state step=1
  state use=""
  state need=""
  state budget=""
  Row between
    Text.caption "Step {step} of 4"
    Text.muted "Laptop finder"
  if step==1
    Column gap:8
      Text.heading "What will you mainly use it for?"
      Button.outline "Work and office apps" -> use="work"; step=2
      Button.outline "Creative work (photo, video, design)" -> use="creative"; step=2
      Button.outline "Gaming" -> use="gaming"; step=2
      Button.outline "School and browsing" -> use="school"; step=2
  if step==2
    Column gap:8
      Text.heading "What matters most for {use}?"
      if use=="work"
        Button.outline "Long battery life" -> need="battery"; step=3
        Button.outline "Light and portable" -> need="portable"; step=3
      if use=="creative"
        Button.outline "A great screen" -> need="screen"; step=3
        Button.outline "Raw processing power" -> need="power"; step=3
      if use=="gaming"
        Button.outline "A dedicated graphics card" -> need="gpu"; step=3
        Button.outline "High refresh display" -> need="refresh"; step=3
      if use=="school"
        Button.outline "Affordable price" -> need="cheap"; step=3
        Button.outline "Durable build" -> need="durable"; step=3
      Button.ghost "Back" -> step=1
  if step==3
    Column gap:8
      Text.heading "What is your budget?"
      Button.outline "Under \$700" -> budget="low"; step=4
      Button.outline "\$700 to \$1,200" -> budget="mid"; step=4
      Button.outline "Over \$1,200" -> budget="high"; step=4
      Button.ghost "Back" -> step=2
  if step==4
    Column gap:12
      Text.heading "Our recommendation"
      Card gap:6
        Text.strong "{use} laptop, tuned for {need}"
        Text.body "Chosen for your {use} needs, with {need} as your top priority."
        Text.muted "Budget band: {budget}."
      Text.caption "Reasons: matches your main use, prioritises {need}, fits your {budget} budget."
      Row gap:8
        Button.ghost "Back" -> step=3
        Spacer grow
        Button "Start over" -> step=1; use=""; need=""; budget=""
